verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports exporting to multiple open formats (Postman v2.0/v2.1, HAR, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, WSDL, cURL, plus its own JSON/YAML) and offers Git Sync so project data lives directly in a user's own repository rather than being locked in the vendor's cloud, satisfying both export and 'leave' aspects. It's also open source (Apache-2.0), reinforcing openness.  missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full data export/migration and any explicit statement about exporting all account/org-level data (not just collections).
